name: Consolidation grants 5% spell and melee/ranged haste (#3074)
contract: Consolidation 706603 ships two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects in Spell.dbc, both with BasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5%: aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed) and aura 192 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (AuraEffect::HandleModMeleeRangedSpeedPct). Together those are the tooltip's "your haste". cast_speed_multiplier reads the native cast-time multiplier and attack_time_ms the hasted swing time, so both are divided by 1.05. Two sibling records also named Consolidation exist (706604, 706609); this scenario covers only the 706603 the issue names.
